newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Metro buys S$22 mln Italian cruise ship.
newsitem.headline: Metro buys S$22 mln Italian cruise ship.

text.p: Singapore's Metro Holdings said on Wednesday it agreed to buy a luxury cruise ship for Singapore S$21.99 million from Italy's Nuove Iniziative Armatoriali Sicilia Srl.
The vessel would be owned and operated by a joint venture company formed on June 3 by Metro, Sembawang Maritime Ltd and Choo Teck Wong, it said in a statement.
The ship, Renaissance Five, has a gross tonnage of about 4,200 tonnes, 57 cabins and a passenger capacity of 127.
Metro said the purchase was conditional on the Italian authorities issuing an export licence for the vessel.
The company said the acquisition would form an integral part of its leisure and cruise business and it intends to target a niche market by offering exclusive and private cruises and charters.

The statement said the purchase was not expected to have any material impact on the consolidated earnings per shares and the consolidated net tangible asset per share of Metro, or the Metro Group, for the current financial year ending March 31, 1998.
